text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm..., it might be time for a replacement 
soon~. I've washed it quite a few times 
already, after all—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I'll put on a brand-new ribbon and 
get Trai-chi to praise me~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This shade of blue is so hard to find, 
too~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for a while, she would have to 
make do with the old ribbon...
